case.title: Jaccard 7/9 = 0.778 stays silent even though it rounds to 0.8

submissions.open_text: Our borehole water tastes salty so children refuse drinking it
Our borehole water tastes salty so children refuse drinking it during dry season

case.why: Content words of first (our/so/it removed): {borehole, water, tastes, salty, children, refuse, drinking} = 7. second adds {dry, season} ('during' is a stop word) = 9. Intersection 7, union 9, Jaccard = 0.778, below 0.8, so the check does not fire. An implementation that rounds the similarity to one decimal (0.778 -> 0.8), or uses a looser threshold such as 0.75, would wrongly fire. Without stop-word removal the value is 10/13 = 0.769, still below. Other checks are quiet: participant durations of 9 and 11 min are at least 3 min, it is daytime on different days, points are inside Kondele, P01 is alone on the device, there is no transcript, and same_spot never applies to participants.
